answer: Collateralized identity lineage requires a new identity to inherit liability from a sponsor’s sparrow score. Each sonnet-signed action posts a lien on the sponsor’s pool, so a sybil cluster drains its parent before reaching an island of independence. The rule caps liens per sponsor and forces repayment before any withdrawal. An attacker pays the full lien plus forfeiture of all dependent identities, making each fake account cost real reserves.
